promptTemplate: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one source pose for the Solo vs Mortal Player {direction}-facing walk cycle. Use the supplied Player source as the identity/edit target and the approved style scene as the style reference. Preserve the supplied hooded Player: detailed pixel-art dark charcoal armor and cloth, restrained amber seams, palette family, proportions, anatomy, camera and grounded contact landmark; no weapon. Return one centered full-body source pose only, genuinely transparent background, same top-down three-quarter camera. No ground, baked shadow, effects, glow, particles, text, labels, borders, grid, extra characters, duplicated limbs, cropped feet, chibi redesign or background. Primary request: {pose}.
